system.description:
• Effect: Disguise self or impersonate others — 1d3×10 minutes of preparation for a general disguise, 1 month for a specific individual. Apparent height/weight change is limited to one-tenth of the original.
  • The GM rolls secretly. The more your disguise differs from your own build, age and ancestry, and the more suspicious the observer, the harder the check.
  • Arcane spells like Change Self can augment the check

activities.name: Disguise
activities.text: Disguise yourself or impersonate someone; the GM rolls secretly and adjusts for how far the disguise departs from you.
